description: Save a COMP as a .tox into TouchDesigner's native Palette folder so it appears in the Palette browser for drag-and-drop reuse.

category.description: Palette subfolder to group the component under

comp_path.description: Path to the COMP to export, e.g. /project1/base1

name.description: File stem for the .tox (default: the basename of comp_path)

palette_dir.description: Explicit palette folder to use. Empty resolves TouchDesigner's user palette folder live.

name: export_palette_component
title: Export palette component
